_note: design-cb FINAL ruling on the F18b checkout step, 2026-10-17. The single-ticket checkout page keeps its route (the redirect is withdrawn): it lives at /tickets/<slug>, pinned by the lead (the /national-show/ prefix in the ruling was a slip); findCheckout requires 200 with form[data-nos-ticket-form] there, and the hub CTA must go to it. It renders TicketPurchaseForm. Checkout BEHAVIOUR does not change: same payload, server validation (excludedDays, caps), test-mode banner and admin gating.

summary.rule: Under the existing hero: the chosen ticket as a TicketCard in a read-only summary variant (prop variant="summary"): the same stub, photo, field colour, name, when-line and price as the hub card, with NO stepper and NO Buy/CTA. Exactly one card on the page, horizontal (stub on the right) when its container is >= 470px, stacked at 390.

form.rule: day=D preselects that day in the same .days fieldset (native radios, 58px cells); day-specific products only (the weekend pass has NO day picker). quantity=N fills the one 44px stepper (min 1; the decrease button carries a U+2212 minus text node OR the same icon the hub stepper uses, with its accessible name intact; a hyphen-minus or en dash is never accepted). The per-day '–/0/+' rows (DayQuantityPicker, data-day-row, legend 'Tickets per day') and the 0 default are removed: one quantity for the chosen day.

total.rule: Under the stepper, beside the CTA, one price format (R150, never R150.00).

cta.rule: At quantity 0 the button stays enabled; a click shows the hint inline and moves focus to it (the hint region carries tabindex=-1).

provisional.rule: Stays on public at checkout, restyled to the shared 14px/500 label in ink-700, under the price in the summary card, exactly once on the page (never in both the summary and the form) whenever the price is provisional.

payload.note: Measured from components/tickets/useTicketCart.ts and app/api/tickets/checkout/route.ts at main: body { showId, lineItems[] }, one line item per ticket, chosenDay optional (YYYY-MM-DD). The redesign must not change this shape; the check intercepts the POST, fulfils it with a 400 so nothing is reserved, and compares.

mustStay: viewerIsVerifiedAdmin() on the checkout page and the hub
